title: Developer capabilities across web and mobile
summary: Reusable visualization capabilities with a coherent experience across platforms.
contribution: I contributed API and feature design, cross-platform consistency, rendering, validation, and developer guidance alongside other engineers.
lesson: A shared abstraction should preserve meaningful behavior, with compatibility and accessible use considered alongside visual output.

title: Dependable mobile experiences
summary: Telemetry-led investigation and partner collaboration to improve routine product use.
contribution: I worked on investigation, monitoring, accessible interaction, and recovery behavior, collaborating with partner engineers on fixes.
lesson: Reproducible scenarios make disagreement constructive. Validate the measurements and test failure states, not just the normal path.

title: AI-enabled product integration
summary: Making useful AI capabilities fit familiar workflows.
contribution: My work spans mobile interaction components and product integration, with design and partner teams. I focus on the user task and a practical delivery path.
lesson: Adapt an implementation to its platform and make ownership clear. Experiments, validation, and shipped features are different stages.

title: Engineering assistance and team enablement
summary: Less repetitive preparation. More useful context for engineers.
contribution: I built personal and team automations and early engineering-tool experiments, supported hands-on AI learning, and mentored teammates.
lesson: Generated output still needs evaluation. Useful workflows need feedback, maintained context, and clear ownership.
